Release notes for Self-Hosted Deployment in Amazon Web Services

Version 1.3.0 — June 8, 2026

Breaking changes

Mini-USF version 2 upgrade

Upgraded Mini-USF to version 2.

Fixed issues

  • Fixed a post-install permissions error.

Version 1.2.3 — May 20, 2026

Fixed issues

  • Fixed external UVCS workspace discovery.

Version 1.2.2 — May 6, 2026

New features

Automatic solution onboarding

The 
upc-onboarding
post-deployment job now runs on AWS, so the platform is usable immediately after installation.
The job is idempotent and is therefore safe to run on every deployment.
